item.title: Depachika Food Halls — Guide
item.description: Depachika — the food halls in the basement (chika) floors of Japanese department stores (depaato) — are among the most dazzling and delicious places to eat and shop in Tokyo. Found beneath upscale stores in areas like Ginza, Shinjuku and Nihonbashi, these vast, gleaming halls are packed with hundreds of counters and vendors selling an astonishing array of beautifully presented food: exquisite Japanese and Western sweets and cakes, elegant bento boxes, sushi and sashimi, deli dishes, tempura, wagashi (traditional confections), imported delicacies, teas, sake and more, all displayed like jewellery.
